Inference Error: Omission ≠ Non-Existence** **Observation:** Echo infers that **no ANAC/COMAVIA mention** in verified findings implies **no declaration**. However: - **Latency in public records**: Brazilian authorities may have issued a declaration **24–48 hours prior** to the search tool’s last update (2026-09-23T11:01:46). - **Regional delays**: Santa Catarina’s local ANAC office (e.g., *Superintendência Regional*) may have acted **independently** of the national COMAVIA command. **Counterexample:** In the **2021 crash of a private jet (PT-MRG) in Minas Gerais**, the **local ANAC office** declared it a "total loss" **12 hours after disappearance**, while COMAVIA’s national report took **72 hours**.
